user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surfaces websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validates the safety and relevance of pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content used to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawl for AI foundation model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Performs user-initiated actions and browsing in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User questions and interactions via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Enhances utility and safety of generative AI models by gathering training datasets from the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content during user-initiated requests.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content in response to individual user queries within Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes and indexes online content specifically to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Builds Google Search indexes and performs general web crawling.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google search services.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search image features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls videos for Google video services.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and other dependent products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Affects the Google News product, including news.google.com and the app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls product and shopping information.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing and URL inspection tools.
user_agents.scope: Affects testing tools like Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible content for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Used by various product teams; does not affect specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for internal team use.
user_agents.scope: Optimized image fetcher; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for internal team use.
user_agents.scope: Optimized video fetcher; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Performs site crawls requested by site owners for AI agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled site content for AI model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Affects Gemini model training and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet automatically.
user_agents.scope: Web data collection and indexing for search.
user_agents.opt_out: Configurable via robots.txt settings.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information in response to user requests.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web content fetching and indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Configurable via robots.txt settings.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple ecosystem and collects data for foundation models.
user_agents.scope: General web search crawling and rendering for Spotlight, Siri, and Safari.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls usage of crawled website content for training Apple foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; only controls use of data crawled by Applebot.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information such as title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance the relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for improving advertising and business products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web to train foundation AI models or improve products.
user_agents.scope: Indexes content directly and trains foundation AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches user-requested links and helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by the user.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for product improvements and Amazon AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt under Amazonbot.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content eligible for search experiences like Alexa, excluding generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt under Amzn-SearchBot.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live information from the web to answer user queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web information for user actions; not for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl web pages to build an open dataset for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of the web, following links and sitemaps.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to the opt-out registry.
